## Description (paste as plain text)

Invite your guests to an animated Christmas party invitation they open like a real envelope. Edit it in minutes with no code, then share one link by WhatsApp, text or email.

✨ WHAT YOUR GUESTS SEE
• A sealed envelope with their own name and a wax seal. One tap breaks the seal and the card slides out
• Gentle snowfall and twinkling string lights
• A live countdown to your party
• Date, time and address, with one-tap Google Maps directions
• Add to calendar (Apple, Google, Outlook)
• Dress code with colour suggestions, or an "Ugly sweater required!" badge
• Evening schedule, menu and Secret Santa rules (turn any section on or off)
• Built-in RSVP: guests choose yes or no, the number of guests and dietary notes
• Optional Christmas music, which only plays when a guest taps the music button

🎨 3 THEMES INCLUDED
• Classic: red, green and gold
• Elegant: midnight navy and champagne gold
• Cozy: tartan plaid and warm wood
Each theme changes the colours, fonts, envelope, seal and decorations.

🎄 FOR ANY HOLIDAY GATHERING
The wording adapts automatically for: Christmas Party, Christmas Dinner, Christmas Eve, Holiday Party, Office Holiday Party and Ugly Sweater Party. You can also write your own text.

💌 PERSONAL LINKS FOR EACH GUEST
Paste your guest list and get one link per guest. Each guest sees "Dear Sarah" or "Dear The Smith Family" on the envelope, and their name is already filled in on the RSVP form.

📩 RSVPS STRAIGHT TO YOUR PHONE
Choose how replies reach you:
• WhatsApp: the guest's reply opens as a ready-to-send message to your number
• Email: the reply opens as a ready-to-send email to you
• Your own form link (for example a Google Form)
No account, no app and no monthly fees.

🖥 SO EASY TO EDIT
Open the editor in your browser and fill in a simple form. The invitation updates live as you type. Add your family photo, pick a theme, and save your draft to come back later. No coding and nothing to install.

✅ HOW IT WORKS
1. Purchase and download the files
2. Open the editor on a computer and fill in your details
3. Download your finished invitation
4. Publish it with Canva (step-by-step guide included) to get your link
5. Share your link by WhatsApp, text message or email

📦 WHAT YOU GET
• Easy editor (editor.html)
• Invitation template (index.html)
• Step-by-step PDF guide

⚠️ PLEASE NOTE
• This is a digital download. No physical item will be shipped.
• Use a computer (laptop or desktop) to edit. Guests can open the invitation on any phone or computer.
• You need a Canva account to publish your invitation. Another free option is also explained in the guide.
• RSVPs arrive by WhatsApp, email or your own form. There is no guest list dashboard.
• For personal use. Please do not resell or share the files.
• I created this invitation and its editor with the help of AI tools.
• Because this is a digital product, returns are not accepted. If anything is unclear, send me a message and I'll gladly help.

Merry Christmas and happy hosting! 🎁
